rows.text: A decree of 'Le Président de la République', 'Vu l'article 8 de la Constitution', published in JORF n°127 of 3 June 1997 (NOR HRUX9702065D), decrees 'M. Lionel Jospin est nommé Premier ministre' and closes 'Fait à Paris, le 2 juin 1997.', signed 'Jacques Chirac'.

locator.item: reference block ('NOR : HRUX9702065D', 'JORF n°127 du 3 juin 1997'), the article appointing the Prime Minister and the signature line

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-37 only (Premier ministre, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff; this batch covers the first ten people to hold the office in the period). The Prime Minister's letter presenting the Government's resignation, the decree ending the Government's functions, the decree appointing a Prime Minister, a decree countersigned or signed by the Prime Minister and a later decree's reference to an appointment stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Président de la République, ministers, party offices and continued handling of current affairs are excluded.
